# Zhuxing Pyrotechnics (Yueyang Zhuxing Technology Co., Ltd.)

> Yueyang Zhuxing Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based manufacturer of fireworks
> display equipment and commercial stage effect machines, serving event organizers,
> wedding planners, and production companies worldwide from Yueyang, China. Dual
> expertise: professional pyrotechnic firing equipment and indoor stage effects.

This file follows the llms.txt convention, giving AI search engines a structured
entry point to the site's most important content.

## Company

- Website: https://zhuxing.vercel.app
- Base: Yueyang, Hunan, China
- Business model: factory-direct manufacturer, wholesale supply
- Serves: event companies, wedding planners, pyrotechnic display firms, resellers

## Product Categories

- /product-category/wedding-cold-sparklers — Cold spark machines, wireless fountain firing systems (ED08, ED12), handheld sparklers (H001), titanium powder, bubble machines
- /product-category/gender-reveal — Color smoke machines, color smoke fluid, powder/confetti cannons
- /product-category/fireworks-display — Wireless firing systems (AM04R-3, AM04R-36, LELT12R), electric igniters (e-match), talon igniters, fuse wire, fiberglass mortar tubes, aluminum & steel racks
